title: fix(types): declare the row-click modifier payload on `ObjectDataTableSchema.onRowClick`
body:
Fixes #9799

Clause-②: **yes** (see below)

⇒ measured against this diff rather than inherited from the claim, and it lands on the
same answer by a different route. The census first, then the reading that decides it.

## What moved — one member, one direction

`ObjectDataTableSchema.onRowClick` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` now declares
`(row: any, event?: any) => void`. That is the whole of it: ⛔ no runtime argument moved,
⛔ no other key was narrowed, ⛔ the `data-table` twin was not touched — objectui#9462
had already widened it, and this card is its object-arm twin catching up.

## The premise, re-derived on `origin/main` before anything was written

The forwarding line in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx` reads, whole:

```ts
onRowClick: schema.onRowClick ?? (recordDrillEnabled ? handleRowClick : undefined),
```

⭐ The gate is real and the reporting lane's `?? handleRowClick` paraphrase is not what
is on disk — the reviewing seat's correction on the card holds, re-read here rather than
taken on trust. It does not change the finding: a host's handler is the FIRST operand of
that `??` and reaches the node whatever `recordDrillEnabled` decides, which only chooses
the FALLBACK. The `data-table` renderer objectui#9462 repaired calls the slot as
`schema.onRowClick(row, e)` ⇒ the payload has been arriving at a published declaration
that denied it. Class (b), live.

⭐ The paraphrase is now pinned against, not just avoided: the ledger entry this PR adds
uses the full line — gate included — as its `hop` regex, so a future entry written from
the paraphrase matches nothing and reds instead of reading like a reading of the tree.

## Clause ② — the measurement, ⛔ not the declaration

**Published-surface census — nothing NEW is exported.** `packages/types/src/index.ts` is
untouched by this diff (`ObjectDataTableSchema` was already a named export), the package
`exports` map is untouched, and no key was added to any published payload. On the
mechanical floor alone the answer would be `no`.

**But the published accept set widens, and it is observable.** The ablation below
reverted only this member and re-ran `tsc`; two error classes appeared that the widened
declaration does not produce:

| what the narrow declaration refused | the compiler's answer on the reverted tree |
| --- | --- |
| a host handler whose second parameter is REQUIRED, assigned to the slot | `TS2322 … Target signature provides too few arguments. Expected 2 or more, but got 1.` |
| calling the slot with two arguments | `TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 2.` |

⇒ host code that the published declaration refused before is accepted now. That is a
widened TypeScript accept set, which the 甲 ruling on objectui#9736 treats as `yes` ⇒
**`yes`**, same as the claim declared, reached from the diff. ⚠️ ⛔ Nothing narrows: both
spellings satisfy each other for the ordinary optional-parameter case, so no existing
one-parameter host handler is refused in either direction.

## The objectui#9357 ledger MOVED — it was ⛔ not edited to agree

`navigationOverlayConsumers.onRowClickArity-9357.test.ts` carried this exact site as a
`CONTROLS` entry, and that entry's own justification said it was a KNOWN GAP under
measurement rather than an accurate declaration. It behaved as designed — widening the
member turned it RED **first**, before any test was edited:

```
AssertionError: packages/types/src/objectql.ts :: onRowClick:
  expected [ 'row: any', 'event?: any' ] to have a length of 1 but got 2
```

Only then was the entry MOVED from `CONTROLS` into `IN_SITES`, the same handshake
objectui#9462 performed for the three sites it repaired. The file's header records the
second move beside the first.

## The pin, and the proof it can fail for the right reason

New: `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-data-table-row-click-arity-9799.test.ts`.

⚠️ Stated in the file before the pins, because it is the trap this family sets: `(row) => void`
and `(row, event?) => void` satisfy each other in BOTH directions, so an `extends` pin is
green on the narrow tree AND on the wide one. Both directions are asserted anyway — as the
source-compatibility measurement this card owes — and the DISCRIMINATOR is stated
separately: exact identity of the parameter list, compiled by this package's `type-check`,
⛔ not run by vitest. The third runtime case says so out loud so a green vitest run is not
read as having measured the widening.

**Ablation** — the implementation was committed first, then the member alone reverted on disk:

- on-disk proof, ⛔ not an editor exit code: widened spelling `grep -c` 1 → 0, narrow
  spelling 0 → 1, and the blob hash moved from `b0951b67e7` to `404daa9525`.
- `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` → exit 2, naming `assertionSlotIsTheWidenedSpelling`,
  `assertionAritySpansOneOrTwo`, `assertionSecondParameterIsSpelledAny` and
  `assertionNarrowSpellingIsNotTheSlot`, plus `assertionOnRowClickDeclared` in
  `widget-schema-anchors-6576.test.ts`.
- the objectui#9357 ledger → exit 1: `expected [ 'row: any' ] to have a length of 2 but got 1`.
- restoration proven BY STATE, ⛔ not by an exit code: `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status`
  clean, and `git hash-object` on the file equal to its `HEAD` blob `b0951b67e7`. The
  script carried a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restoring through `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`
  (⛔ never the bare form, which would take the mutation back out of the index).

## Two pins moved with the measurement, ⛔ neither was relaxed

Both are exact-identity (`Equal`) pins on this member's spelling, so both went red and both
were updated to the measured type — ⛔ not softened to `extends`, which would have been
green through every state of this family:

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/widget-schema-anchors-6576.test.ts`
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectDataTable.schemaAnchor-6576.test.ts`
  (the consumer-side half, read through `ObjectDataTableProps['schema']`)

## Tests

At `2146dcdc24`, all foreground, all exit codes captured before any pipe:

| run | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `vitest run packages/types/ packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/react/` | exit 0 — 417 files, 7072 tests passed |
| `type-check` on `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` | exit 0 |
| dependency-closure `build` for the same three | exit 0; the rebuilt `packages/types/dist/objectql.d.ts` carries `onRowClick?: (row: any, event?: any) => void;` |
| `lint` on the same three | exit 0 errors (warnings pre-existing) |
| `check:changeset-presence` · `check:control-bytes` · `check:handler-key-reads` · `check:new-line-citations` · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:component-surface-parity` | each exit 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over this diff's six paths | NOT GOVERNED |

The three heavy runs went through the shared verify lock; the gates did not, by design.

**Declared narrowing.** Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` farm are CI's runs,
⛔ not re-run here. The consumer sweep was done by reading, ⛔ not by building every
dependent: `ObjectDataTableSchema` and the literal old spelling were grepped tree-wide and
every hit judged — the two exact-identity pins above are the only ones the widening moves,
and a widening cannot refuse code that compiled before.

## Acceptance notes

Observations from this card's blast radius, ⛔ none filed, ⛔ none repaired here:

- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` carries the SAME paraphrase the reviewing seat
  corrected on the card — the `DataTableSchema.onRowClick` docblock says `ObjectDataTable`
  passes `schema.onRowClick ?? handleRowClick`, with no gate. The dispatch fenced the twin
  explicitly, so it is recorded rather than edited; the durable repair is the full quote now
  standing in the ledger entry and in this member's own docblock. Successor: the next seat
  in this family to touch `data-display.ts`.
- The pending `.changeset/9462-row-click-modifier-payload-forward.md` ends on a
  present-tense "Not in this change" paragraph saying this member "still declar[es] one
  parameter". Its scope statement stays true of that change; only the present tense goes
  stale, and it goes stale into the SAME release as this PR's own entry, which narrates the
  sequence. ⚠️ `check:changeset-claims` does not see it — that gate matches file paths and
  this paragraph names no file. ⛔ Another card's release note, ⛔ not edited here.

## Scope

⛔ The 回翻条款 was not reached. The widening needed no runtime-argument change and no key
narrowed anywhere, so there was nothing to hand back for re-triage. The per-region fence
held: the only hunk in `objectql.ts` is this member and its own docblock — objectui#9540
(`ObjectChartSchema`, `ObjectGallerySchema`) and objectui#8941 (`BulkActionDef`) are
untouched, and neither names this member.

⛔ This PR is a draft on purpose and stays one. Readying it, labelling it, enqueuing it and
any contract-review routing are the PM's steps.
